approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 58 Chapter 743
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 3904-B, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to  amend the energy law, the executive law and the public
        service law, in relation to critical energy infrastructure secu-
        rity and responsibility"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This legislation would give the Public Service  Commission  (PSC)  and
the  Division  of  Homeland  Security  and  Emergency  Services  (DHSES)
increased authority  to  protect  New  York  State's  electric  and  gas
distribution  infrastructure  against  physical  harm caused by cyberat-
tacks.
 
  Cyberattacks against critical infrastructure, including in the  energy
sector,  have  shown the need for strong cybersecurity protections. This
legislation would ensure that sectors of the energy system  overseen  by
State entities have minimum cybersecurity standards that are at least as
robust as existing federal requirements.
 
  I  strongly  support this bill. However, it required certain technical
amendments to ensure customer privacy and to codify the  PSC's  existing
authority to regulate the customer's consented disclosure of consumption
data.  I  have secured an agreement with the Legislature on these points
and am signing this  bill  with  the  understanding  that  it  will  not
conflict with any Federal Energy Regulatory Commission requirements.
 
  On  the  basis  of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill into
law.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______
